dogecoin.text: @LibertyBlitz Isn't all of crypto down? Even at its current price $doge is still up a ridiculous amount for the year. I bought in at .13 and sold at .60. I'll try to do the same again. If you get into crypto prepare yourself for 80% swings.

$doge has been seeing a decent bounce back. After some good news with $btc I could see some nice upside in our future. Maybe not ATH but I'd be happy with anything over .30. What I've made so far in the last few days have been pretty sweet.
